text: Natural language processing, or NLP, is a branch of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand and use human language. Instead of just reading words, NLP allows machines to grasp the meaning behind them, such as tone or intent. This technology powers many tools we use daily. For example, automatic translation services can convert a sentence from English to Spanish instantly. In business, sentiment analysis examines customer reviews to determine if feedback is positive or negative. Additionally, chatbots—virtual assistants on websites—use NLP to answer questions and solve problems. While NLP is not perfect, it continues to improve, making communication between humans and machines smoother and more natural every day.
